data.summary: Cybersecurity professional with extensive experience supporting CISOs and executive leadership in driving enterprise security strategy, cyber risk management, governance, compliance, and cyber resilience initiatives. Proven expertise in cybersecurity governance, vulnerability management, security operations, IAM, SIEM, cloud security, application security, third-party risk management, and security control assessments across large-scale enterprise environments.
